# DrBristol

A set of functions to compute $p$-values and perform sensitivity
analysis, adapting Fisher’s $p$-value test to case studies and process
tracing following López and Bowers (2025). It uses unbiased and biased
urn models to draw null distributions in the absence of randomization.

# Installation Instructions

Since this is a package still under development, we have not yet
submitted it to CRAN. You can install it directly from Github using the
following commands:

``` r
library(remotes)
install_github('bowers-illinois-edu/DrBristol')
```

# Quick Start

# Name of the Package

We name our package after Dr. Murial Bristol, better known as “the tea
lady” in Fisher’s $p$-value demonstration. Fewer people are aware that
the “lady” was a fellow researcher of his at the Rothamsted Research
institute. Beyond being a brilliant scientist herself, Dr. Bristol could
indeed taste whether tea or milk were poured first into a cup, or so
evidence suggests.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`e_from_p()`](https://bowers-illinois-edu.github.io/DrBristol/reference/e_from_p.md)
  : Calibrate p-values into e-values
- [`find_e_two_types()`](https://bowers-illinois-edu.github.io/DrBristol/reference/find_e_two_types.md)
  : E-values for the +1 hypergeometric urn model
- [`find_odds_multi()`](https://bowers-illinois-edu.github.io/DrBristol/reference/find_odds_multi.md)
  : Calculate the difference between the p-value and a p-value threshold
  for the multiple types of information model
- [`find_odds_two_types()`](https://bowers-illinois-edu.github.io/DrBristol/reference/find_odds_two_types.md)
  : Calculate the difference between the p-value and a p-value threshold
  for the two types of observation model
- [`find_p_multi_max_p()`](https://bowers-illinois-edu.github.io/DrBristol/reference/find_p_multi_max_p.md)
  : Multi-rival testing: Max-P approach
- [`find_p_multi_mv()`](https://bowers-illinois-edu.github.io/DrBristol/reference/find_p_multi_mv.md)
  : Multi-rival testing: Multivariate Approach
- [`find_p_two_types()`](https://bowers-illinois-edu.github.io/DrBristol/reference/find_p_two_types.md)
  : Find a p-value given a certain number of observations in favor of
  the working hypothesis among a total number of observations when there
  are two types of observations
- [`generate_compositions()`](https://bowers-illinois-edu.github.io/DrBristol/reference/generate_compositions.md)
  : Generate all compositions of n into k parts
- [`sens_obs_multi()`](https://bowers-illinois-edu.github.io/DrBristol/reference/sens_obs_multi.md)
  : Sensitivity analysis for urn models with two types of information
- [`sens_obs_two_types()`](https://bowers-illinois-edu.github.io/DrBristol/reference/sens_obs_two_types.md)
  : Sensitivity analysis for urn models with two types of information
- [`sens_urn_evalue()`](https://bowers-illinois-edu.github.io/DrBristol/reference/sens_urn_evalue.md)
  : Sensitivity analysis in the e-value scale
